purpose: Metamodel correspondence from the user-supplied jacamo_v2_complete.ecore source of truth to USE 7.5.0 metamodel concepts. This V2 supersedes the old reconstructed DSML4JaCaMo structural vocabulary for V2 migration; concrete project parsing, runtime state synchronization, receiver resolution and OCL/deontic execution remain later layers.

resolvedDependentSources: Moise organisation XML and referenced organisational sources

semanticBoundary.inputToMapper: JaCaMo semantic model parsed/resolved from the project
semanticBoundary.rule: The V2 structural mapping is keyed only by declared V2 Ecore identity. Project parsers may resolve JaCaMo/Jason/CArtAgO/MOISE sources, but filename/class-name heuristics never replace declared metamodel identity.

oclStage.policy: OCL profiles/constraints are applied after structural/verification projection; Norm is never translated into OCL merely because it is normative.

sourceEvidence: UseModelApi: native EnumType, MClass, MAttribute, MAssociation construction
MModel: enum/class/association registration and navigable-role conflict checks
use-plugin ActiveBaseline/MappingLoader/MappingModel/TransformationPlanner: active V2 enum, opposite, order and projection consumers
targetUSE.validationScope: The V2 mapping contract is exhaustively cross-checked against jacamo_v2_complete.ecore and the USE 7.5.0 grammar/API surface, including keyword escapes, eOpposite deduplication, independent order projection, navigation namespaces, defaults and requiredness metadata. Active consumers are migrated and text/direct USE compilation, negative mutation, trace, OCL, runtime mapping, mirror, verification and multi-case gates passed before the Phase 44 freeze.

datatypeMappings.target: native USE EnumType with the same enum name and EEnum literal name

policies.enumMapping: Each EEnum becomes one native USE enum. Target literal identifiers use EEnum literal.name (not literal text) so hyphenated serialized literals such as intra-group remain valid and reversible.
policies.classMapping: Each V2 EClass becomes a USE class with the same name. V2 declares no abstract EClass and no eSuperType.
policies.attributeMapping: Each declared V2 EAttribute becomes a scalar USE attribute. Primitive ETypes map directly; EEnum-typed attributes use the mapped native USE enum type. Explicit Ecore defaults are recorded but effective-default application remains a materialization concern.
policies.inheritanceMapping: Each eSuperType would map to USE inheritance; V2 currently declares none.

containmentReferenceMapping.forwardRole: exact EReference name unless a USE keyword requires a reversible target-only escape
containmentReferenceMapping.globalContainmentGuard: Per-link inverse 0..1 is necessary but not by itself a proof of Ecore global single-container identity across different containment references. Instance materialization must preserve the source eContainer and reject conflicting containment links.

nonContainmentReferenceMapping.withoutEOpposite: association; unknown inverse multiplicity *; generated reverse helper is non-authoritative
nonContainmentReferenceMapping.withEOpposite: emit exactly one USE association for the EReference/eOpposite pair; copy both declared end multiplicities and use both declared role names; both navigations authoritative
nonContainmentReferenceMapping.forwardMultiplicity: copy the EReference lower/upper at the target end

identifierPolicy.metamodelElements: Preserve owner-qualified V2 source identity exactly. Apply target-only escapes only when USE grammar reserves the exact lowercase member/role identifier.
identifierPolicy.projectObjectIdentifiers: deterministically sanitize to USE identifiers; preserve original JaCaMo identifier in transformation trace
identifierPolicy.generatedConcreteArtifactClass: use resolved Java simple class name; on collision append a stable short hash of the fully-qualified name

policies.sourceExpressionPolicy: Jason Event/Plan/Belief/AGoal textual expressions and MOISE condition/time strings remain String unless a separately verified semantic parser introduces a typed representation. They are never silently parsed as OCL.
policies.enumValuePolicy: Serialized EEnum literal text is resolved through the EEnum declaration and materialized as <EnumName>::<EEnumLiteralName> in USE.
policies.constraintPolicy: Mapping establishes the USE semantic substrate. OCL constraints remain separate; Norm is never translated into OCL solely because it is normative.
policies.oppositePolicy: Every declared EReference is covered exactly once. For an eOpposite pair one entry emits the canonical association and the partner entry is an alias binding to the same target association, preventing duplicate links.

evolutionPolicy.unchangedElement: reuse mapping only when owner/type/bounds/containment/opposite semantics are unchanged
evolutionPolicy.addedEClassEnumOrFeature: generate mapping suggestion but require review
evolutionPolicy.removedOrRenamedElement: mark stale and BLOCK; never silently retarget by similarity
evolutionPolicy.versioning: V1 reconstructed vocabulary -> V2 source is a semantic/breaking major mapping revision

policies.attributeRequirednessPolicy: USE class attributes do not encode Ecore lowerBound multiplicity. Every EAttribute lowerBound is therefore preserved as source metadata and enforced by the later instance-materialization gate: lowerBound=1 requires a resolved source value, except that an explicit Ecore default may be materialized as the effective target value. A required source attribute must never become undefined in a snapshot claimed to faithfully represent the source model.
policies.explicitDefaultPolicy: An explicit Ecore defaultValueLiteral is provenance, not a value to discard. When the source value is unset, later materialization must use the mapped targetDefaultExpression as the effective target value. Whether the source was explicitly set versus defaulted may be retained in trace metadata; structural USE attributes alone do not encode eIsSet.
policies.navigationPolicy: Navigation records distinguish source Ecore navigation names from target USE navigation names. sourceForward/sourceReverse refer only to declared Ecore features; targetForward/targetReverse refer to actual USE role names after generated reverse roles and target-only keyword escapes. No field may mix the two namespaces.
policies.orderingPolicy: Association/composition preserves membership. Every many-valued ordered source EReference has a target-only rank projection; source navigation reconstructs a Sequence by rank. Each authoritative eOpposite direction has independent ranks. USE link insertion order is never source order.

verificationProjections.name: ConcreteArtifactTypeProjection
verificationProjections.source: Parsed JaCaMo project: Artifact.type plus externally confirmed concrete CArtAgO implementation type
preconditions: Artifact.type resolves to a concrete implementation identity
parser/source resolver confirms CArtAgO Artifact ancestry or equivalent project declaration

target.rule: Generate one concrete USE subclass of Artifact per distinct resolved implementation type.

verificationProjections.trace: Preserve fully-qualified implementation type as trace metadata. Artifact.type is the V2 structural anchor; never infer the class from Agent/action names.

metamodelContract.purpose: Expose a resolved concrete Artifact implementation as a USE subtype.
assumptions: Concrete Java/CArtAgO type resolution is external to the structural Ecore.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No baseline structural data is removed; Java behavior is not represented by the subtype.

verificationProjections.name: ObservablePropertyStateProjection
verificationProjections.source: Parsed concrete Property owned by an Artifact implementation/instance
verificationProjections.structuralRepresentation: Preserve Property object and R034 composition.
verificationProjections.runtime: Current property value may materialize as !set on the concrete artifact object.
verificationProjections.fallback: If value type cannot be resolved reliably, keep structural Property(name,arity) only; never infer a state type from arity or literal text.
verificationProjections.reason: Enables natural OCL state invariants/pre/postconditions while preserving the V2 structural Property concept.

metamodelContract.purpose: Project a resolved observable-property value to a typed attribute on a concrete Artifact subtype.
assumptions: Property.name is structural; value type/value require project/runtime evidence.
Generated member must not collide with mapped attributes or navigations.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: Structural Property remains. Concrete Java/runtime value semantics are outside this projection.

verificationProjections.name: CArtAgOOperationProjection
verificationProjections.source: Parsed concrete Operation owned by an Artifact implementation
verificationProjections.structuralRepresentation: Preserve Operation object and R033 composition.

target.name: Operation.name
target.parameters: externally resolved ordered parameter names/types; count must agree with Operation.arity
target.resultType: externally resolved result type when meaningful, otherwise no result

verificationProjections.fallback: If a full signature cannot be resolved, keep structural Operation(name,arity) only. Arity alone is insufficient to invent parameter types or names.
verificationProjections.oclCapability: Resolved projected operations anchor USE OCL pre/postconditions.

metamodelContract.purpose: Expose a resolved CArtAgO operation signature as a USE operation.
assumptions: Full ordered signature comes from CArtAgO/Java resolution; V2 Ecore provides only name/arity.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: Structural Operation remains; guards/internal Java behavior/effects are not inferred.

verificationProjections.name: ExternalActionOperationConsistency
verificationProjections.source: Action.operation -> Operation, constrained semantically by Action.kind=EXTERNAL
verificationProjections.target: Reuse mapped association R027; when VP003 exists, trace structural Operation to its projected MOperation.
verificationProjections.purpose: Supports Jason external-action ↔ CArtAgO operation consistency without inventing receiver/execution semantics.

metamodelContract.purpose: Reuse the V2 action-operation structural relation.
assumptions: Action.kind must be EXTERNAL for an environment-operation interpretation; INTERNAL actions must not be forced to an Operation.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; receiver resolution and execution are not inferred.

verificationProjections.name: ObservablePropertyBeliefConsistency
verificationProjections.target: Reuse mapped association R028; VP002 may additionally project the concrete property value.
verificationProjections.purpose: Supports environment observable-property ↔ Jason belief consistency checks while preserving V2 direction.

metamodelContract.purpose: Anchor V2 belief-to-property correspondence for later verification.
assumptions: The relation does not itself prove percept delivery timing or belief synchronization.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; runtime synchronization semantics remain outside this layer.

verificationProjections.name: OrganisationalGoalAgentGoalConsistency
verificationProjections.purpose: Supports agent-goal ↔ MOISE organisational-goal correspondence in the direction declared by V2.

assumptions: No achievement/satisfaction lifecycle is inferred from the static link.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; runtime satisfaction semantics are outside scope.

verificationProjections.name: NormPreservation
verificationProjections.source: Norm including enum type, condition/timeConstraint, role and mission relations
verificationProjections.target: Represent Norm as USE class/object with native NormType attribute plus mapped associations only.
verificationProjections.forbiddenTransformation: Do not compile obligation/permission into OCL automatically without a separately proved deontic translation contract.
verificationProjections.purpose: Keep MOISE normative structure distinct from ordinary OCL state/operation constraints.

metamodelContract.purpose: Preserve V2 normative data and links without deontic-to-OCL invention.
assumptions: NormType is a native USE enum; condition/timeConstraint stay strings unless a later formal parser is proven.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; deontic interpretation/execution remains intentionally outside this mapping.

initialSnapshot.useAction: !insert (<firstEndObject>, <secondEndObject>) into <MappedAssociation>; eOpposite alias entries must not emit a duplicate insert

operationReplay.when: runtime/event adapter provides a concrete projected operation invocation
operationReplay.effectMaterialization: Apply observed !set/!insert/!delete changes between enter and exit before postcondition evaluation.

runtimeMaterialization.directApiAlternative: A plugin may construct/update MModel and MSystemState directly. For V2 it must create EnumType declarations before enum-typed attributes and must deduplicate eOpposite pairs to the one canonical mapped MAssociation.

reviewFlags.note: USE 7.5.0 supports native EnumType, but current plugin MappingModel/MappingLoader V1 do not parse enumMappings.
Role.agents/Agent.roles, Agent.workspaces/Workspace.agents and Agent.artifacts/Artifact.agents are authoritative bidirectional pairs; emitting both as independent associations would be wrong.
USE grammar reserves lowercase context; map to ecore_Plan_context while preserving source identity.
USE grammar reserves lowercase role in association-end syntax; target navigation role is ecore_Norm_role while source identity remains Norm.role.

USE grammar reserves lowercase operations. V2.0 already emitted ecore_Artifact_operations but failed to list the escape in identifierPolicy and used an ambiguous navigation.forward string. V2.1 makes the escape explicit and separates sourceForward from targetForward.

42 EAttributes have lowerBound=1. USE scalar attributes do not structurally encode Ecore attribute multiplicity; V2.1 records sourceRequired and a deterministic absence/default materialization policy instead of implying structural equivalence.
V2 structural Ecore intentionally lacks full concrete property value types and operation signatures; projections remain evidence-gated.

reviewFlags.source: Repository V2 migration and freeze gates
reviewFlags.note: Active consumers select exact V2 resources without fallback. USE compilation, negative mutation, transformation, trace, OCL, runtime mapping, mirror correctness, verification and two-case regression gates pass; historical V1 loaders remain explicit reproducibility paths only.

contract.identityRule: Feature identity always includes its declaring owner. eOpposite partner identity is explicit; bare feature names are never lookup keys.
contract.reverseRoleRule: Use declared eOpposite role when present. Otherwise generate source_<feature>; owner-qualify every colliding generated reverse role. Target-only USE keyword escapes are reversible and never change source identity.
contract.orderingRule: Association/composition preserves membership. Every many-valued ordered source EReference has a target-only rank projection; source navigation reconstructs a Sequence by rank. Each authoritative eOpposite direction has independent ranks. USE link insertion order is never source order.
contract.containmentRule: Map containment to USE composition with source/container at the first/aggregation end and per-link inverse 0..1. Materialization must additionally preserve the source eContainer globally across all containment references.
contract.oppositeRule: One canonical USE association represents each bidirectional EReference/eOpposite pair; both source references remain separately traceable through one emitted canonical entry plus one alias entry.
contract.enumRule: Map EEnum to native USE EnumType. Use EEnum literal.name as the USE identifier and retain EEnum literal text/value for reversible serialization.
contract.valueRule: Preserve EType and explicit-default provenance. Instance default materialization is a later stage. Enum source literals are mapped through enumMappings, never treated as arbitrary strings.
contract.projectionRule: VP001-003 remain conditional typed templates that require external concrete project facts. VP004-007 reuse V2 structural bindings and do not duplicate them.
contract.compatibility: 2.2.0 adds target-only independent order ranks (V2-ORDER-001, user-approved). Ecore bytes and supported source domain unchanged. Consumers of 2.1 must migrate navigation, trace and runtime order updates.
contract.navigationRule: sourceForward/sourceReverse are Ecore identities; targetForward/targetReverse are actual USE navigations after escaping/generated roles. For absent eOpposite, sourceReverse is null and targetReverse is explicitly generated/non-authoritative.
contract.attributeRequirednessRule: EAttribute lowerBound is preserved as sourceRequired/sourceMultiplicity. Because USE attributes have no Ecore multiplicity syntax, requiredness is a mandatory instance-materialization validity gate; required no-default values must resolve, and explicit defaults must materialize as the effective target value when the source is unset.
contract.explicitDefaultRule: Explicit Ecore defaults are mapped to targetDefaultExpression and applied at materialization when the source is unset. The static V2 mapping does not pretend that USE MAttribute declarations alone encode Ecore default/eIsSet semantics.
contract.compilerGateRule: FROZEN records completed exact source coverage, active V2 consumer migration, actual USECompiler compilation, negative mutation gates and refreshed fingerprints/manifests. Any future semantic change requires a new version, structural diff, impact analysis and full affected regression; hashes must never be edited merely to silence a gate.

externalProjectionRequirements.evidence: Property declares only name and arity; a typed projected USE state attribute requires independently resolved value type evidence.
externalProjectionRequirements.decision: Do not synthesize an EAttribute or infer a type from arity/name/literal text.

externalProjectionRequirements.evidence: Operation declares only name and arity; a projected MOperation requires an independently resolved full ordered signature.
externalProjectionRequirements.decision: Do not synthesize parameter names/types or result type from arity.
